question: What distinguishes awareness from inert matter in terms of measurability?
premises: Limited manifestation is the characteristic of the inert.
Awareness is distinct from the inert.
inference: Because awareness cannot be measured, it is fundamentally different from inert matter, whose defining mark is limited manifestation.
plain_english: It has been said that limited manifestation is indeed the characteristic of the inert; awareness is distinct from the inert because it is not measured.
